    out = prefix[width - 1 :].copy()
    out[1:] -= prefix[: n - width]
    return out
'''
s=s.replace("Runs in O(n) time with a running total.","Runs in O(n) time from prefix sums. Prefix sums may wrap around int64,\n    but the differences are still exact when each window sum fits.")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
